highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded script constants.
highlights_body: Preview 2 adds GPU correctness fixes for reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clipping and affected Mali Vulkan device-loss paths. SkiaSharp's managed API surface remains unchanged; HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script fields.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled rendering engine to Skia m158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed APIs or C bridge declarations.
Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0. This is a native engine upgrade, unlike Preview 1's 14.4.0.300 package revision, which retained HarfBuzz 14.4.0.
HarfBuzzSharp.Script adds Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, Seal and 27 previously omitted constants. Existing fields and values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact.
Corrects zero-length square-capped hairline sizing under reflected transforms and rounds Ganesh text-atlas indices before sampler selection to avoid choosing the wrong atlas.

Bounds Graphite clip recording per render pass, rejecting and logging draws whose clips cannot fit a fresh pass instead of overflowing. Adds a delay only on affected device-loss paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 HarfBuzzSharp.Script constants. It also corrects reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, and adds a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss workaround.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while its native engine remains at 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script fields and values remain unchanged, as do parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU rendering corrections to the Skia m158 line.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script fields. Rendering fixes cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted device-loss workaround for affected Mali Vulkan drivers.
